title: Hearing New Orleans bands as a child
summary: At seven or eight in New Orleans he heard Buddy Petit, the Silver Leaf band, Chris Kelly and Kid Nichols.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When did you first get to New Orleans?
Oh, I was in New Orleans when I was seven or eight years old.
When you got down in the morning. Can you remember what kind of music you heard there? Any of the bands or piano players? Oh, yeah.
I heard Buddy P.T. play. I heard the Silver Leaf Band they had in New Orleans at the time.
Dance? They were a dance band. Dance band. And also I heard Chris Kelly.
Kid Nichols. Who was Kid Nichols?
He's a trumpet player too. He's a trumpet player too. Um... Did you work in New Orleans then pretty early too?
